text: /noindex The Cities of Sigmar are visions of civilisation and hope made manifest. Gleaming metropolises built around the towering bastion of a Stormkeep, they are heavily fortified against the armies of darkness. Within their high walls, aelf, duardin and human thrive in peaceful coexistence. This page contains all of the rules you need to field your Cities of Sigmar miniatures on the battlefields of the Mortal Realms, from a host of exciting faction rules to a range of warscrolls. The rules are split into the following sections:

section: Designers’ Commentary > Battletome: Cities of Sigmar
text: Q: Does the ‘Overheating’ ability remove one heat token or one heat token for each 5+? A: One heat token for each 5+.

Cities of Sigmar armies can use the following abilities: Start of Battle Round FORM UP! : Once the order is given, shieldwalls and cannon batteries link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. The unit using this ability and the targets: cannot be under orders . must each be a different unit type. Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders . Designer’s Note: ‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll ( Core Rules, 4.0 ), e.g. ‘ Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal ’ or ‘ Cannonade Cogfort ’. Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase TAKE AIM! : While their shield-slogging comrades keep the foe at bay, sharpshooters rain down punishing volumes of fire on helpless foes. Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders to use this ability. Effect: Pick 1 of that unit’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn. Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a unit that is under orders SOUND THE ATTACK! : As the piercing note of a war-horn sounds, shields shift aside to permit cavalry and hollering assault troops to sally forth and engage the foe. Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability. Effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6. Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase INTO THEM, YOU DOGS! : Sigmarite officers demand remarkable feats from their warriors, leading them into the furnace of battle with a rousing speech and a sword held high.

Sigmarite officers demand remarkable feats from their warriors, leading them into the furnace of battle with a rousing speech and a sword held high. Declare: Pick a friendly HERO that is under orders to use this ability. That unit is the field officer for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non- HERO units that are under orders and wholly within 12" of the field officer to be the targets. Effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the field officer uses a FIGHT ability , you can pick a target that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn. That target is inspirited and the other target is emboldened . The inspirited target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by the field officer has been resolved. Then, if the emboldened target has not used a FIGHT ability this turn, it can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the inspirited target’s FIGHT ability has been resolved. Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase HURL THEM BACK! : After the enemy has spent their fury, the Sigmarites heave forward, shoving their foes off balance and leaving them open to a killing blow. Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability. Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons.

You can pick 1 of the following battle formations for a Cities of Sigmar army. Each battle formation grants a different ability you can use in the battle. BATTLE PROFILE Name Points Stalwart Guardians 0 Collegiate Exemplars 0 Zealous Hordes 0 Swift Reinforcements 0 Veteran Cannoneers 40 Fearless Exemplars 0 Thrall Warhost 0 Grudgebound War Throng 0

Passive TO THE LAST : Determined to safeguard all that they cherish, the Sigmarites charge into battle to reinforce wavering battlelines. Effect: Each time a friendly unit that is under orders uses the ‘ Rally ’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

Passive MASTERS OF THE ARCANE : The battlemages of the Collegiate Arcane might be intimidating and occasionally aloof, but their sorcery perfectly supplements a fighting formation. Effect: Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly WIZARDS that are under orders . Designer’s Note: WIZARDS in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.

Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Your opponent declared a FIGHT ability THRONGS OF THE FAITHFUL : All that remains in these Sigmarites’ hearts is a burning desire for vengeance against the reavers who slaughtered their loved ones. Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly SIGMARITE units that target the enemy unit using that FIGHT ability .

Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase DAWNBRINGER CRUSADE : Pouring forth from the Cities of Sigmar, the Dawnbringer Crusades seek to reconquer and reconsecrate the Mortal Realms in the name of the God-King. Declare: Pick a friendly non- HERO CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability. Effect: If that unit is in combat , it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat. If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move. KEYWORDS MOVE

Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase CANNY CREWS : The crews of these Great Cannons are so well trained they often fire the perfect shot, blasting off the heads of monsters or mowing down ranks of the enemy. Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Ironweld Great Cannon units to be the targets. Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a SHOOT ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll , or 1 wound roll , or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic.

Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase FRONT-LINE LEADER : The officars of this army are the stuff of Dawnbringer legend, hard-bitten veterans that stand with the troops through thick and thin. Their exemplary behaviour and courage inspires their soldiers to fight all the harder when the going gets tough. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN INFANTRY HERO to use this ability. Then, you can pick up to 1 friendly NON-HERO HUMAN INFANTRY unit and up to 1 friendly HUMAN WAR MACHINE unit that are wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets. Effect: While the targets are wholly within 12" of that HERO , add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target INFANTRY unit’s melee weapons and the target WAR MACHINE unit’s ranged weapons until the start of your next turn.

On 1st June 2027, these rules will move over to Warhammer Legends. This means that they will no longer be legal for competitive play Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round HAVE NO MERCY : Their mistress’s commands echoing in their minds, the aelves of the Darkling Covens are compelled to murder the foe with pitiless efficiency, their dark-hearted kin joining them in the slaughter. Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target. Effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.

On 1st June 2027, these rules will move over to Warhammer Legends. This means that they will no longer be legal for competitive play Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase I’VE SEEN WORSE AND KILLED BETTER : The duardin who battle for the Cities of Sigmar are as gruff and critical as they are loyal, courageous and bold. Little can move them once their mind is set or their feet planted. Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN units that did not charge this turn to be the target. Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

( HERO only excluding Cannonade Cogfort and Conqueror Cogfort ) BATTLE PROFILE Name Points STENTORIAN GENERAL 0 BELOVED LEADER 0 GRIZZLED DRILLMASTER 0 Passive STENTORIAN GENERAL : This hero’s bellowed threats are so intense that the enemy cowers before them. Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders . Passive BELOVED LEADER : Such is the esteem in which this officer is held that their soldiers would march into the jaws of death without fear. Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders . Passive GRIZZLED DRILLMASTER : This warrior is a grim-faced veteran who mercilessly drills regiments under their command, not out of cruelty but from a desire to ensure their survival. Effect: Other visible friendly units have WARD ( 6+ ) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders .

HERO only BATTLE PROFILE Name Points ASTUTE TACTICIAN 0 DRAW STEEL! 0 COSMOPOLITAN LEADER 20 Your Hero Phase ASTUTE TACTICIAN : This Sigmarite has spent as much time with their nose in military tomes as they have knee-deep in the spilled guts of their foes. Their erudition in the subject of battlefield manoeuvres is highly regarded. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target and add 2 to run rolls for the target. Any Combat Phase DRAW STEEL! : With a bellow, the officar lunges into battle, and their troops follow them with as much steel in their hearts as they wield in their clenched fists. Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. Your Hero Phase COSMOPOLITAN LEADER : This officar has trained under and alongside all the myriad factions that dwell within the walls of the Cities of Sigmar. Their knowledge of many different fighting styles and disciplines is a rare quality. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit is HUMAN , pick up to 3 eligible units to be the targets instead. Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn: If the target is HUMAN , add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks . If the target is DUARDIN , add 1 to charge rolls for the target. If the target is AELF , add 3 to the target’s control score .

You can pick a heroic trait from this table instead of from other Heroic Traits tables available to this faction. ( HERO only excluding Cannonade Cogfort and Conqueror Cogfort ) BATTLE PROFILE Name Points PIOUS VETERAN 0 BRISTLING ATTITUDE 0 COSMOPOLITAN LEADER 0 Passive PIOUS VETERAN : The quiet strength of this warrior’s faith is such that tiny miracles manifest around them wherever they go Effect: Each time you pick targets while declaring a PRAYER ability used by a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST , if this unit is eligible to be picked, you can pick it to be an additional target. Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a visible unit within 12" of this unit BRISTLING ATTITUDE : Many enemy assaults falter in the face of this general’s fiery yet determined resistance. Effect: Spend any number of rage dice . If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll X dice, where X is the number of rage dice spent. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the charge roll . Your Hero Phase COSMOPOLITAN LEADER : This veteran has trained under and alongside soldiers from all walks of life across the Cities of Sigmar. Their knowledge of many different fighting styles and disciplines is a rare quality. Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non- WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. Effect: Spend 1 rage dice for each target. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to wound rolls for each target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

section: Artefacts of Power > Treasures of the Cities
text: ( HERO only, excluding Cannonade Cogfort and Conqueror Cogfort ) BATTLE PROFILE Name Points THE LAST BLADE OF EMBERGARD 0 BONES OF SAINT IGNIFUS 0 THE SPHERE CELESTIAL 0 Deployment Phase THE LAST BLADE OF EMBERGARD : This chipped and scratched blade grows steadily hotter as allies and enemies fall, fuelled by the fury of battle. Effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit’s non- Companion melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon’s Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle. Reaction: You declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders BONES OF SAINT IGNIFUS : The seventh Supreme Pontifex of the Sigmarite faith, Ignifus perished in the act of slaying the Nightmare of Vandium. His bones thrum with righteous power. Effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability. Your Hero Phase THE SPHERE CELESTIAL : By cranking the dials on this incredibly sophisticated artefact, the bearer can manipulate space and time on a local level, swapping the position of themselves and another willing ally. Declare: If this unit is not in combat , pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY or CAVALRY HERO that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit. Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat.

text: Then, remove the target unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use MOVE abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0 ).

An Ironweld Innovation is a unique enhancement that can be given to Cannonade Cogforts and Conqueror Cogforts . A unit can only have 1 Ironweld Innovation. BATTLE PROFILE Name Points PROTOTYPE ARCO-COMBUSTOR UNINHIBITOR 0 EMERGENCY BELLOWS 0 GRAPPLE-NET LAUNCHER 0 Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase PROTOTYPE ARCO-COMBUSTOR UNINHIBITOR : This device accelerates the burning of a Cogfort’s emberstone fuel, allowing sudden and shocking bursts of motion. Effect: For the rest of the turn: Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic. This unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities. End of Any Turn EMERGENCY BELLOWS : This cogwork mechanism pumps cool air into an overheating arco-combustor. Effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s heat tokens . Once Per Battle, Enemy Combat Phase GRAPPLE-NET LAUNCHER : This hull-mounted defensive device flings a steel-mesh net at onrushing foes, trapping them fast and nullifying their attacks. Declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target. Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

section: Spell Lore > Spells of the Collegiate Arcane
text: Your Hero Phase 6 SPEED OF THE TWIN-TAILED COMET : Banners blaze with ethereal fire and trail comet-like contrails as the Freeguilders hurl themselves forward to meet the enemy. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non- WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them. KEYWORDS SPELL, UNLIMITED Your Hero Phase 7 CURSE OF SCORCHED METAL : The wizard causes the weapons of their foes to grow unbearably hot, searing their flesh to the bone. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an ATTACK ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that ATTACK ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the ATTACK ability has been resolved. KEYWORDS SPELL Your Hero Phase 6 HIGH STAR’S LIGHT : The mage summons a simulacrum of Sigendil, the High Star of Azyr, to inspire their allies to the greatest heights of valour. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. KEYWORDS SPELL
BATTLE PROFILE Name Points Scriptures of Sigmar 0

Your Hero Phase 3 HOLY AEGIS : A shimmering barrier manifests around the beneficiary, dulling the impact of enemy attacks. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase. KEYWORDS PRAYER, UNLIMITED Your Hero Phase 5 RECKONING OF SINNERS : Searing oratory causes enemies to be stricken by the weight of the sins and outrages they have committed against the God-King’s folk. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets. KEYWORDS PRAYER Your Hero Phase 3 BENEDICTION OF THE HIGH HEAVENS : The priest beseeches Sigmar to rain down restorative blessings upon his faithful, seeing lacerations heal and broken bones reknit. Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick another visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. Effect: Heal (D3) the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead. KEYWORDS PRAYER

Decorations for Valour are unique enhancements that can be given to CITIES OF SIGMAR units that have the CHAMPION keyword. A unit can only have 1 Decoration for Valour. BATTLE PROFILE Name Points TWIN-TAILED COMET OF HONOUR 10 THE LIVING CITY CROSS 10 AQSHIAN ORDER OF MERIT 10 Passive TWIN-TAILED COMET OF HONOUR : Bearing one of the holiest symbols of Sigmar, this medal is awarded for exemplary acts of gallantry Effect: While this unit has any champions , add 5 to this unit’s control score . Passive THE LIVING CITY CROSS : Having spent many years deployed in the wilds of Ghyran, this warrior has trained their troops to use camouflage and guerrilla-style survival techniques. Effect: While this unit has any champions , subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit. Passive AQSHIAN ORDER OF MERIT : Awarded to distinguished veterans of battle in the Realm of Fire, this medal marks out those who have protected their allies against Aqshy’s rage-inducing effects. Effect: While this unit has any champions , if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the ‘ Eruption of Fury ’ ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit. Army of Renown

When you pick the Cities of Sigmar faction for your army, you can choose for it to be an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown . If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Cities of Sigmar faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES keyword. ROSTER OPTIONS Any non- UNIQUE SIGMARITE units For each Sigmarite unit you include, you can include: Up to 1 ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES DUARDIN unit Up to 1 ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES AELF unit You cannot include Regiments of Renown You must include 1 SIGMARITE unit for each AELF unit and each DUARDIN unit you include.

section: Allies of the Free Cities > Battle Traits
text: Start of Battle Round FORM UP, ALLIES! : Once the order is given, humans, aelves and duardin alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against. Declare: Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. The unit using this ability and the targets: cannot be under orders . must each be a different unit type. Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders . Designer’s Note: ‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll ( Core Rules, 4.0 ), e.g. ‘ Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal ’ or ‘ Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard ’. Passive FORCES OF ORDER : The soldiers who stand shoulder to shoulder against the evil ravaging the Mortal Realms are hardy and bold, and they take strength from their shared bonds of fellowship. Effect: While 3 friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the AELF keyword, 1 of those units has the DUARDIN keyword and 1 of those units has the SIGMARITE keyword: Those units have WARD ( 5+ ) against shooting attacks . Add 3 to those units’ control scores . Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks .

section: Allies of the Free Cities > Heroic Traits
text: ( HERO only) Reaction: You declared the ‘ Redeploy ’ command for a visible ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit wholly within 18" of this unit RESPECTED COMMANDER : This commander is hailed as a paragon of virtue by all goodly beings, and their orders are followed with the utmost haste. Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

section: Allies of the Free Cities > Artefacts of Power
text: ( HERO only) Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase SIGNET OF THE CITY : This piece of jewellery is bestowed upon those who have performed a great service to one of Sigmar’s cities, giving their opinion considerable weight in matters military. The bearers do tend to overstep their authority, however, countermanding earlier orders and sowing confusion. Declare: Pick this unit and each visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets. Effect: For the rest of the turn: The targets are under orders . The targets have WARD ( 6+ ) . The targets have a maximum control score of 1.

section: Allies of the Free Cities > Spell Lore
text: Your Hero Phase 7 THESE REALMS ARE OURS : The allies of Sigmar share a desire to restore civilisation and stability to the realms, whatever the cost. Declare: Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES WIZARD to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Effect: For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units have Charge (+1 Damage) for attacks that target enemy units that are contesting the target objective. KEYWORDS SPELL, UNLIMITED

section: Allies of the Free Cities > Prayer Lore
text: Your Hero Phase 5 DIVINE MANDATE : Sigmar’s quest to drive Chaos from reality and reconquer the Mortal Realms imbues his faithful with his dread aspect of war, that of a furious and all-conquering warrior king. Declare: Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets. KEYWORDS PRAYER, UNLIMITED

When you pick the Fyreslayers, Kharadron Overlords or Cities of Sigmar faction for your army, you can choose it to be a Duardin Ascendant Army of Renown . If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Fyreslayers, Kharadron Overlords or Cities of Sigmar faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the organisation below. All units in your army gain the DUARDIN ASCENDANT keyword. ROSTER OPTIONS Grombrindal (must be include and must be your general } Any ORDER DUARDIN unit REGIMENT OPTIONS You cannot include Regiments of Renown You cannot include MANIFESTATIONS You cannot include faction terrain

Passive DUARDRAZHAL : Grombrindal's goal is no less than the reunification of all the scattered, noble duardin nations. Effect: Friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT units are unified while they are wholly within 12" of at least 1 FYRESLAYERS , 1 KHARADRON OVERLORDS and 1 CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN unit. Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase 'AS THE ANCESTORS INTENDED!' : To stand with far-flung kin in hours of crisis bolsters every duardin preacher. Declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to be the target. Effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase 'PAH! NOW THIS IS A SHOT...' : Duardin gunners of every creed never miss an opportunity to show their superior craft before their kin. Declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit to be the target. Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn . Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase 'AS ONE, KINFOLK!' : The children of the ancestor gods surge across the field as one mighty throng. Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY units to be the targets. Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3. Once Per Turn (Army), Any Comhat Phase 'SETTLE EVERY GRUDGE! KHAZUK!' : When fighting as one, the duardin are a red-handed force of raw vengeance. Declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit to be the target. Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

HERO only Passive TIRELESS PURPOSE : This duardin lord shares Grombrindal's vision for their people, and their fervour is infectious. Effect: Each time a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ' Normal Move ' ability, add 2" to the distance that unit can move as part of that ability.

section: The Duardin Ascendant > Artefacts of Power
text: HERO only Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase VALAYAN HEARTH-BANNER : Wrought in the image of she who guards hold and hearth, this runic standard is a salve to even severe wounds - for those who believe. Declare: Pick each friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT unit on the battlefield to be the targets. Effect: Heal (D3) each target.

Your Hero Phase 4 SPIRIT OF THE WHITE DWARF : When Grombrindal takes the field, even the most sceptical Kharadron cannot help but feel a flicker of divine awe. Declare: Pick a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. Effect: The target is unified until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1. KEYWORDS PRAYER, UNLIMITED Your Hero Phase 4 OATH OF RESTORATION : All that which once belonged to the duardin will be theirs anew - so swear those who hold faith in Grombrindal. Declare: Pick a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible objective within 18" of them that is contest ed by 2 or more friendly unified units to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT units have WARD ( 6+ ) while they have any models contesting the target. If the chanting roll was 7+, friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT units have WARD ( 5+ ) while they have any models contesting the target instead. KEYWORDS PRAYER Army of Renown

When you pick the Cities of Sigmar faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the Iron March Army of Renown . If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Cities of Sigmar faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the IRON MARCH keyword. Commanders of the Iron March, Engineers of the Iron March and Iron March Auxiliaries are unique enhancements that can be given to IRON MARCH WAR MACHINES . A unit can only have 1 of each unique enhancement. ROSTER OPTIONS Cannonade Cogfort Immolator Cogfort Conqueror Cogfort Linebreaker Cogfort For each Conqueror Cogfort and Linebreaker Cogfort you include, you can include: up to 1 Mallus Forgepriest up to 1 unit of Freeguild Gallants You cannot include Regiments of Renown or faction terrain

Start of Battle Round FORM UP, IRON MARCH! : Once the order is given, Cogforts and infantry alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against. Declare: Pick a friendly IRON MARCH unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly IRON MARCH units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. The unit using this ability and the targets: cannot be under orders . must each be a different unit type. Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders . Your Hero Phase 4 THE CHANT OF IRON : The alliance between Grungni the Maker and Sigmar the God-King is writ large upon the priest’s brow as divine creation and celestial wrath combine. Declare: Pick a friendly IRON MARCH PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick either a visible enemy unit within 18" of them or a visible friendly IRON MARCH unit that is wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. KEYWORDS PRAYER, UNLIMITED

Steel and blackpowder are the lifeblood of the Cities of Sigmar, but so is relentless vigilance. The Fusil-Platoons of the Sigmarite armies represent all three. Deployed as mobile gunnery brigades, their job is to seek out enemies trying to outmanoeuvre or ambush the slower battlelines and then blast them out of hiding. They also patrol the vulnerable outer borders of nascent strongpoints as dedicated sentries. Each platoon is led by a Fusil-Major carried to battle by an Ogor Warhulk. This respected commander uses their high vantage to call out encroaching foes for destruction. His steady orders direct the withering fire of Freeguild Fusiliers. Anything spared this storm must either contend with a solid wall of pavises or the brute strength of an ogor's tower shield. The presence of an Alchemite Warforger enhances the potency of these soldiers' weapons, as well as lending some arcane might. Meanwhile, seasoned Wildercorps Hunters slip around the flanks to flush out the enemy or harry them with well-placed bolts. This Spearhead army consists of the following units: General Fusil-Major on Ogor Warhulk Units 1 Alchemite Warforger 5 Freeguild Fusiliers with 1 Blackpowder Squire token 5 Freeguild Fusiliers 11 Wildercorps Hunters

Although, at its core, the tactical doctrine of Sigmar’s mortal armies relies upon massed firepower and defence in depth, there are times when Freeguild commanders must be more flexible. On occasions where the deployment of a full army corps is not viable, smaller formations such as the Castelite Company will be dispatched to seize vital ground and defend it against threats. Commanded by an experienced Cavalier-Marshal who has displayed particular adaptability and initiative in the face of the enemy, a Castelite Company specialises in absorbing the fury of an enemy attack before unleashing a devastating riposte in return. Freeguild Steelhelms form a sturdy core, advancing into battle with shields locked together, relying on discipline and faith to hold the line against whatever horror comes at them. With this anvil in place, the process of breaking the enemy upon it can begin. An Ironweld Great Cannon sends bone-shattering ordnance blasting through the enemy ranks, while the Cavalier-Marshal leads a thunderous counter-charge to sweep them from the field. Freeguild Cavaliers sing Sigmarite battle-hymns as they crush the opposition beneath the grinding hooves of their destriers or bash in their skulls with hammers and flails. This Spearhead army consists of the following units: General Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal Units 5 Freeguild Steelhelms 5 Freeguild Steelhelms 5 Freeguild Cavaliers 1 Ironweld Great Cannon

Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round THE OFFICAR'S ORDER : Reading the flow of battle, a ranking Freeguilder dispatches an order that could well turn the tide in the Sigmarites’ favour. Declare: Pick a battle tactic card in your hand and place it face-down separately next to your other battle tactic cards . The information on it is still hidden from your opponent but make it clear which card is separate. The card stays separate until you use the command on it or score the battle tactic on it as described below. Effect: When you use the command on that card, it is not discarded but returns to your hand. Your opponent can check the information on it before it returns to your hand. The card goes back to being a normal battle tactic card, with the exception that you cannot use the command on it in the same phase it went back into your hand. If you did not use the command on the card you separated, you can still score the battle tactic on it at the end of your turn as normal if you met its conditions. If you do so, discard it as normal. If you neither used the command nor scored the battle tactic on the card, it automatically returns to your hand at the end of your turn. Designer’s Note: This ability essentially lets you use a command ‘for free’, but you have to choose the command at the start of the battle round, so it requires some planning ahead!

It takes especially hard-bitten souls to fight in Embergard. Many Freeguilders are sent to this vital bastion, but only the most vicious survive to achieve veteran status. Those who do often slip outside typical chains of command, gravitating towards charismatic captains proven in battle. They become known as Sentinels of Embergard, determined to defend the corpse-city. Jorvan Kreel, Heir of the Kraken, is one such leader: a debonair, if gloryhungry, ranger from fallen Anvilgard. Alongside his faithful ash panther Thexa, he now roams the City of Ash, harrying the ratmen from their holes. He is invariably accompanied by the uncompromising elite of the Freeguild Grenadiers, whose incendiary arsenal and heavy bardiches are suited to savage urban fighting, as well as the armoured and honour-bound Gallants. Kreel is hardly a man of faith, but he appreciates its power. Often, then, he is accompanied by a Mallus Forgepriest – warrior-priests whose bellowed orisons inspire holy purpose in their fellows This Spearhead army consists of the following units: General Jorvan Kreel, Heir of the Kraken (Thexa, the ash panther, is a token) Units 1 Mallus Forgepriest 5 Freeguild Gallants 5 Freeguild Grenadiers 5 Freeguild Grenadiers

For all the terrible potency of its cannons and Cogforts, faith is the bedrock of the Sigmarite war machine: faith in the indomitable power of the God‑King and in the cause of justice. Few beings in existence represent the power of such belief as much as Pontifex Zenestra, the legendary Matriarch of the Great Wheel. Several times has she been recorded as slain, only for her to manifest anew wherever the need of the God-King’s folk is greatest, encouraging the faithful to oil the wheel of progress with their own blood. Zenestra’s Zealots are the fanatical soldiers that escort the Pontifex into battle, knowing that their souls are safest by her side, even if their bodies might be blasted and torn. Zenestra selects the most pious Freeguild Marshals and their Command Corps to accompany her, relying upon these veteran warleaders to temper the righteous fury of the Steelhelm infantry with tactical nous. Full of zealous drive, these stubborn souls would rather perish in agony than fail their saintly leader.
